description: A Java class implementing a log filtering node that outputs only message content, used within a logging pipeline to simplify log output by omitting metadata.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class that passes only the message content to the next log node, omitting metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a next LogNode to which filtered logs are forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message by forwarding only the message part to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
